cc:Work.dc:title: Milano - mappa rete metropolitana (schematica) (Treni derivative)
cc:Work.dc:description: Derived from "Milano - mappa rete metropolitana (schematica).svg" by Arbalete and Wikimedia Commons contributors (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Milano_-_mappa_rete_metropolitana_(schematica).svg), used under CC BY-SA 4.0. Arbalete is named as author; the file has also been revised by Arrow303, Zio27 and Emanuele Lorenzo Corti. Modifications for the Treni app: hidden duplicate layer removed; line paths combined and labelled M1-M5; station markers grouped under a Stations layer and given internal par_* identifiers.
